rows.text: calls `Actor_GetWorldPosition(rdx)` with three stack dword out-slots and zeroes the second; calls `VMValueStack_PopNumericDiscard(r9)` four times and lays the floats out as two stack triples (second, 0, first) and (fourth, 0, third); calls a 158-byte helper with pointers to the (fourth, 0, third) triple, the (second, 0, first) triple and the out-slot triple, then `VMResult_WriteFloat32(rcx)` with that float result in `xmm1`; the body is wrapped in the stack-cookie check (`01F44830`, `__security_check_cookie`)

reads `VMValueStack_PopInt32CoerceFloat32(r9)`, fills a stack dword buffer through `PartyConfiguration_CollectRuntimeRosterSelectors0To3(buffer, 4)` and calls `VMResult_WriteInt32(rcx, 0)`; for each index below the sign-extended count the roster-selector call returned (signed) whose buffer dword equals the popped value, takes `PartyRoster_GetActorBySlot(index)` and, when it is non-null and either a 32-byte helper of it returns zero or a 70-byte helper of it returns non-zero, calls `VMValueStack_PushInt32(r9, index)` and a 166-byte helper (`rcx`, `rdx`, `r8`, `r9`) and sets a flag; finally calls `VMResult_WriteInt32(rcx, flag)`; wrapped in the stack-cookie check (`01F44830`, `__security_check_cookie`)

looks up a 19-byte lookup helper with the dword at `rcx + 0x120 + 4*r9d` and, through qword `+0x10` of `rdx` (call it Q), stores at `+0x18` of Q's `+0x40` record a 62-byte helper's result for the qword `+0x18` of a 72-byte helper's result for (2, word `+0x60` of the looked-up record); takes bytes from `BattleStats_GetActiveLicenseBoardSelector`, `BattleStats_GetLicenseBoardSelectorA` and `BattleStats_GetLicenseBoardSelectorB` (each with byte `+0x60`), sets bit 0 of dword `+0x8` in Q's `+0x78`, `+0x70` and `+0x80` records to whether each is not `0xFF`, and for the valid second and third (reordered) stores a 180-byte helper's result for (byte + `0x3ED`) at `+0x18` and calls a 126-byte helper; writes a 116-byte helper's index for (word `+0x60`, 3) and words built from 12-bit fields into Q's `+0x60` record; fills dwords `+0x28` to `+0x34` of Q's `+0x0` and `+0x8` records (low 24 bits only, top byte kept) and of its `+0x28`, `+0x30` and `+0x38` records (whole dwords) from a 36-byte helper with `0xFC`/`0xFA` when word `+0xDE0` of qword `0209AC30` equals the indexed dword, else `0xFD`/`0xFB`; calls a 247-byte helper on Q's `+0x50` record and returns 1
